title: Stargate inscriptions at Dendera

tellings.quote: And Ben Van Kirkwick on your show talks about how literal translations at Dandera move to Stargate
And we were just talking earlier that below Danderea, you actually have hieroglyphics that translate to Stargate.
tellings.difference: Told by the host without crediting Ben Van Kerkwyk, and placed 'below' Dendera.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of hieroglyphs at Dendera that translate as 'stargate'.

plain: Hieroglyphs at Dendera, an ancient temple site in Egypt, are said to translate literally to "stargate." Michels tells Joe Rogan he heard this from Ben van Kerkwijk, a researcher of ancient sites, on Rogan's show. In a later episode Michels repeats it himself without crediting anyone, and says the writing is "below" Dendera.
